name: iBitch
source:
One morning the Protagonist! (P!) wakes up to a buzz from his phone.
Aww. Junk mail.
He follows the URL to a site for the "iBitch", which promises control over other people,
and soon he's wielding it on all sorts of idols! Violation!
In the middle of class, in the storage cupboard, at the pool, at the library...
All he wants, with anyone he wants... from Im*s to R*ilgun to PreC*re,
and finally he does them all together!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE119618.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一天早上，主角！（P！）被手机铃声吵醒。
哇。垃圾邮件。
他按照URL访问了“iBitch”网站，该网站承诺控制其他人，
很快他就将它运用到了各种偶像身上！违反！
上课时、储物柜里、泳池边、图书馆……
他想要的一切，和他想要的任何人……从Im*s到R*ilgun到PreC*re，
最后他一起完成了所有这些！

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE119618.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
